title: Change size has soft targets that warn
decision: A Change targets at most 5 slices, 30 changed src files and 8 acceptance scenarios. check-workflow.js warns, rather than fails, past the targets it can count. Exceeding a target at Proposal time means splitting into several Changes rather than writing a larger one.

alternatives.option: Enforce a hard per-change size cap
alternatives.reason: Mature teams use soft targets with explicit exemptions; a hard cap would split large migrations into pieces no reviewer can judge without an approved overall plan.

revisitTriggers: The size warnings are routinely ignored without a Migration trailer.
